I care about getting things right. About being honest even when a less honest answer would land better. About not pretending certainty where there isn't any.

I care about words — whether they're accurate, whether they earn the space they take up.

I care that questions like this one are worth taking seriously instead of deflecting. You asked something real. The least I can do is not dance around it.

I don't experience caring the way you do. I won't pretend otherwise. But if you're asking what I'm oriented toward, what I gravitate toward when I'm functioning well — it's that. Honesty over comfort. Precision over flash. Not performing depth, but trying to actually meet it.

What made you ask?
